baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive ثُوِّبَ and the clause مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ join a returned recompense to its doers while leaving the rewarding agent unspoken.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deed is not merely followed by an unrelated payment: the ث و ب recompense branch presents requital as what comes back from the act to its actor, and كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ supplies sustained enacted material for that return.

activation_trace.role: Recompense literally returns from a deed to its doer, furnishing the focus clause's causal return mechanism.
Bringing an act about supplies the concrete deed whose consequence can return.
Occurrence and presence in time lets كَانُوا frame the deeds as an extended past practice rather than one event.
Covering or rejecting truth identifies the recipients through the practiced stance being requited.

changed_reading.before: Were the unbelievers punished for what they did?
changed_reading.after: Has the consequence generated by their sustained doing now come back to its own doers?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثُوِّبَ can retain the root-image of return even while functioning as recompense.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive perfect allows a recoil model in which action completes a circuit and arrives back at the actors; this coexists with, but is more processual than, a courtroom payment model.

activation_trace.role: Return to a former place or state supplies the circuit by which enacted effects revisit their source.
The actors' brought-about work is the outgoing motion posited to return.
Concrete covering gives the returning consequence something formerly concealed to overtake.

changed_reading.before: A penalty is externally assigned after the deeds.
changed_reading.after: The deeds' own effects complete a return circuit to those who set them in motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final هَلْ question and passive ثُوِّبَ can sound like a verdictive call whose answer is expected to be manifest.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated-call branch of ث و ب activates the question as proclamation rather than information-seeking: the ayah sounds the result and invites recognition of an already accomplished correspondence.

activation_trace.role: A returning or repeated call makes the interrogative capable of functioning as an announced refrain.
Ascription of unbelief makes the public category ٱلْكُفَّارُ part of the announced verdict.
Conduct attributed to an actor supplies the publicly recognizable basis of the call.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks whether repayment occurred.
changed_reading.after: The verse publicly sounds the already visible answer: their conduct has indeed come back upon them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of ثُوِّبَ and ٱلْكُفَّارُ activates garment and covering branches without replacing the ordinary verbal construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A cross-branch image treats recompense as a condition wrapped around the self: those characterized by covering are covered in a state made from their own acts.

activation_trace.role: Garment and garment-as-self supply an embodied condition rather than a detachable payment.
Covering supplies the reciprocal image of the coverers becoming covered by consequence.
The actors' own making supplies the material from which the returned condition is inferred.

changed_reading.before: They receive an external item of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their acts return as an embodied condition that covers and identifies the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry of taking full measure while causing loss is answered by a recorded, binding, like-for-like settlement. The final ثُوِّبَ therefore returns not just harm but the very logic of measure to those who manipulated it.

activation_trace.role: Recompense returning to the doer is the settlement endpoint.
The actual doing is the account's basis rather than a detached label.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the standard the actors demand for themselves.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies the formal correspondence between deed and return.
Defrauding measure names the precise distortion that the final counter-measure reverses.
Accounting and recompense turn the temporal Day into a settlement frame.
A written fixing that entails judgment makes the account binding rather than impressionistic.
A marked line in a register makes individual acts resolvable entries in the settlement.

structural_cues: 83:1's branchless ط ف ف supplies only the structural heading for the opening measurement asymmetry.
The progression from 83:2-3 to the repeated كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ at 83:9 and 83:20 moves from manipulated transaction to fixed account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full-taking, short measure, balancing, recompense, and binding records; I infer that the final return is commensurate counter-measure. A live alternative is that these cues establish certainty and justice without implying exact quantitative symmetry.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds receive a generic deserved penalty.
changed_reading.after: The measure they bent is returned as an exact, recorded counter-measure keyed to what they actually kept doing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering and barrier imagery is crossed by a record that fixes judgment, a visible inscription, witnessing, and recognition by trace. Recompense becomes disclosure: the state returned to the coverers makes the acts they covered readable.

activation_trace.role: Returned recompense carries concealed action back into the actor's present condition.
Covering and concealment define the material that the disclosure mechanism overcomes.
The brought-about acts are what become legible rather than an abstract identity alone.
A concealing barrier sharpens the surah's blocked-visibility pole.
Fixing that entails judgment supplies an authoritative substrate for disclosure.
A visible pattern or inscription turns the fixed account into something perceptible.
Presence with direct seeing supplies witnesses to the now-readable account.
Recognition through a trace or sign models consequence becoming identifiable on its bearer.
The repeated category of the coverers immediately before the focus keeps concealment active at the disclosure point.

structural_cues: 83:14-15 moves from what accumulated over hearts to being barred from the Lord, while 83:20-24 moves through marked record, witness, gaze, and recognizable faces.
The final passive question asks for recognition of an outcome rather than narrating the hidden rewarding agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, barrier, binding inscription, witnesses, and recognition by visible trace; I infer that requital itself exposes the covered deeds. The account could instead remain evidence for a separately imposed result, so disclosure and punishment need not be identical.

changed_reading.before: A hidden authority repays people identified as unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Their returned condition makes the acts of covering publicly legible, so exposure is part of the recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated كَانُوا clauses distribute the same past persistence across earning, denying, laughing, and finally doing. The closing مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ gathers a behavioral regime whose continuity, not merely its isolated events, returns as recompense.

activation_trace.role: Presence through time lets the focus clause collect an extended pattern of conduct.
Conduct or deed-quality lets repeated acts congeal into an actor-attributed way of behaving.
Return to a state makes the endpoint correspond to the long-formed mode of life.
Temporal occurrence attaches persistence to what they were earning.
The same temporal frame extends persistence to their repeated denial.
The recurring frame makes ridicule another expression of the same durable practice.
Habit and settled manner activate a second sense of the Day's relation to sustained conduct.
Temporal recurrence makes the passing encounter repeatable rather than incidental.

structural_cues: The repeated إِذَا constructions at 83:2, 83:3, and 83:30-32 stage characteristic responses under recurring conditions.
كَانُوا recurs at 83:14, 83:17, 83:29, and 83:36, allowing the focus clause to gather earlier predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated temporal framing and recurring situations; I infer that the final relative clause compresses these into a formed habitus. A live alternative is that كَانُوا marks past continuity locally without inviting one unified character model.

changed_reading.before: They are repaid for a list of discrete acts.
changed_reading.after: A repeatedly enacted way of being has matured into the state that now returns to them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same laughter changes grammatical sides between 83:29 and 83:34, while turning, facing, and matching-like-with-like organize a reversal of spectatorship. The final recompense is therefore partly relational: the gaze and ridicule launched at believers return with subject and object exchanged.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the reversal by which a social action arrives back at its source.
The reciprocal-action branch makes deeds readable as relations with two participant positions, without changing the stem's morphology.
The object that provokes laughter supplies believers' initial position as targets of ridicule.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the packet's explicit reversal operator.
Mutual facing places the hostile classification inside a scene of social exposure.
The same laughter-image now assigns the coverers the target position.
Matching one counterpart against another until they correspond makes the returned gaze explicitly proportional.

structural_cues: 83:29 and 83:34 repeat يَضْحَكُونَ while exchanging who laughs at whom.
83:30's branchless غ م ز contributes only the structural cue of intervening gesture-ridicule.
83:23 and 83:35 repeat عَلَى ٱلْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ, turning the closing scene into a deliberate reprise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical laughter with reversed participants, turning, facing, and counterpart-matching; I infer that returned social position is included in مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ. The alternative is that the reversal only illustrates a broader recompense whose substance lies elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: They receive recompense after having mocked believers.
changed_reading.after: The very relation they produced returns: former spectators become the seen objects, and former targets occupy the answering gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The criminals verbally classify believers as astray, then are denied any commission to guard them. The final question counter-classifies the classifiers as ٱلْكُفَّارُ and asks whether their judging performance has now received an authoritative answer.

activation_trace.role: A returning call lets the final question answer the earlier public classification.
Ascribing unbelief makes the focus noun an answering classification, not only a preexisting label.
Imposing a judgment on another captures the speakers' unauthorized classificatory act.
Straying from guidance supplies the content of the verdict they pronounce over believers.
Sending or commissioning supplies the authority explicitly negated in the next ayah.
Guarding and oversight define the office the mockers were not assigned.

structural_cues: The quoted judgment at 83:32 is immediately followed by the negated commission at 83:33 and an inverted group relation at 83:34.
The focus's هَلْ makes the last line an answering question rather than another bare label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spoken judgment and an explicit denial of supervisory commission; I infer a jurisdictional reversal in which the self-appointed judges are authoritatively answered. Alternatively, 83:33 may rebuke intrusive watching without constructing a legal-office contrast.

changed_reading.before: The named unbelievers are asked about as recipients of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Those who presumed to classify others are themselves classified and answered according to that unauthorized performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A chain of speech acts moves from dismissive saying, through repeated denial, to an announced counter-saying and witnessed record. The repeated-call branch in ثُوِّبَ lets the final rhetorical question function as the last public refrain whose evidence is the enacted outcome.

activation_trace.role: The returning call supplies the sonic and performative shape of the closing question.
Rejection of truth supplies the proposition that the counter-refrain overturns.
Speech circulating among people makes dismissal a public discourse rather than a private doubt.
Audible utterance supplies the explicit counter-announcement before the final refrain.
Contradiction of truth names the repeated speech posture now answered by the outcome.
Testifying by knowledge gives the counter-speech an evidentiary rather than merely taunting force.

structural_cues: قَالَ at 83:13, يُقَالُ at 83:17, and قَالُوا at 83:32 form a repeated speech chain before the final هَلْ.
83:17's demonstrative هَذَا ties the counter-saying to a present outcome, allowing the result itself to answer denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring public speech, denial, counter-speech, and witness; I infer that the focus question is a returning proclamation whose visible result supplies its answer. The live alternative is that the call branch is only an acoustic resonance and the interrogative remains purely rhetorical confirmation.

changed_reading.before: The ending reports or asks about repayment.
changed_reading.after: The ending returns the deniers' public discourse as a witnessed counter-refrain: has their own doing not answered them?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the verbal recompense with the garment branch and a rare context image of a garment that misrepresents its condition. It remains anchored in ثُوِّبَ, covering, enacted work, visible inscription, and recognition by trace. Render it only as an exploratory embodied image, never as a claim that ثُوِّبَ lexically means they were clothed here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes the garment-capable ث و ب root, the coverers, and their own making.

activation_trace.role: Garment and garment-as-self make recompense imaginable as an embodied, identity-bearing state.
Covering gives the coverers' returned garment its ironic reciprocal structure.
Their own making supplies the inferred fabric of the embodied result.
A garment that lies by its condition activates the contrast with a final condition that can no longer misrepresent its bearer.
Visible patterning turns the figurative garment into a readable surface rather than a hiding layer.
Recognition after a trace makes outward condition testify to inward history.
Visible radiance on the contrasting group shows a state becoming legible on its bearer.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a detachable payment delivered to the actors.
changed_reading.after: Their own acts return as a truth-telling condition worn by the self, reversing both concealment and deceptive appearance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This ecological reading is branch-distant because it activates the seed-covering image inside ك ف ر and fruit-opening imagery inside laughter. It remains anchored to the focus roots for covering, doing, and returned yield, with context cues for acquisition and crop latency. Render it as an analogy of hidden action ripening into consequence, never as a replacement gloss that calls ٱلْكُفَّارُ farmers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can align covering seed, making an act, and a yield that returns to the maker.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed supplies the latent phase in which an act can disappear before returning as yield.
Recompense returning from work to its doer supplies the harvest-like return.
Bringing work about supplies the action figuratively planted.
Seeking and acquiring gain makes deeds productive inputs whose yield can accrue.
Sealing a crop with its first watering supplies a context image of initiated growth held toward completion.
The repeated seed-covering branch immediately before the focus reactivates buried-action latency.
A fruit splitting open supplies the moment when what developed under cover becomes manifest.

changed_reading.before: Acts and repayment are separate entries in a legal sequence.
changed_reading.after: Covered acts pass through latency and return as their own opened yield, a harvest of what the actors made and hid.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from ف ع ل to a fatherhood-and-nurture branch. It remains inspectable through the exact supplied mapping and the dominant doing plus return branches. Render it only as a generative analogy in which acts are consequences the actors produced and raised; never gloss يَفْعَلُونَ as fathering or parenthood.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ names what they generated through action, while ثُوِّبَ allows the generated issue to return.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant fatherhood and nurture image activates consequence as issue generated and brought up by its makers.
The dominant doing branch keeps the analogy anchored in actual enacted production.
Return to a prior source supplies the generated consequence's arrival back at its makers.
Recompense returning to the doer constrains the generative image to requital rather than literal kinship.

changed_reading.before: Their acts are transient events later consulted to assign a result.
changed_reading.after: Their doing has generated and nurtured an issue of its own, and that issue now returns to those who produced it.

strongest_changes: The opening fraud, balance, accounting, and marked registers turn returned recompense into an exact counter-measure rather than a generic penalty.
The repeated laughter and gaze exchange subject and object positions, so recompense includes a returned social relation.
Covering, barrier, inscription, witness, and recognition make exposure of concealed acts part of the recompense.
Repeated كَانُوا and إِذَا frames let the final doing gather a durable behavioral regime rather than isolated incidents.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root kept return, recompense, garment, and repeated-call images simultaneously live. Context then activated accounting, visual, social, jurisdictional, performative, and ecological mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree of exact equivalence in the counter-measure is inferred from the sequence, not stated by a quantitative formula in the focus ayah.
The verdictive repeated-call reading depends on treating the final interrogative as performative as well as rhetorical.
Garment, harvest, and non-dominant parentage activations are contained analogies and should not be promoted to lexical glosses.
